name: octohog
description: Find UGC creators for your brand, analyze your TikTok and Instagram competitors, and check your creator campaigns, read-only from your Octohog workspace.

interface.longDescription:
Octohog is an AI workspace for UGC marketing, built for DTC brands and creative strategists. Connect it and ChatGPT can find UGC creators for your brand, show what your competitors' content is doing, and report on your creator campaigns.

Find UGC creators (Creator Match): describe the creator you need and set market, age range, language and follower range. ChatGPT returns ranked creators with the reason each one fits. Shortlists and outreach continue in the web app.

Competitor analysis (Radar): Octohog's agent runs daily checks on public TikTok and Instagram activity around each competitor, across their official, team and creator accounts, not only the brand handle. Ask what changed this week, which new creators and content angles are taking off, or how two competitors compare on posts, views and active creators. Answers come with the source posts: hook, caption, stored transcript and views.

Campaign tracking (Creator Tracking): see how a UGC or influencer campaign is doing without chasing status: delivery, top posts, content analysis and every captured post with metrics. Creator Match campaigns show status and outreach counts.

Video Blueprints: finished breakdowns of a TikTok or Reel (hook window, beats, on-screen text and ending), so ChatGPT can turn a winning structure into a brief your creator can shoot.

TikTok Creator Deep-Dives: a creator's typical performance, posting cadence, and top, worst and pinned videos, so you judge an account by more than one viral post.

Ask Otto: Octohog's AI marketing analyst answers open questions grounded in your workspace. Built-in prompts cover a weekly competitor summary, a script in a competitor's style, campaign status, quiet creators and what to brief next.

All 14 tools are read-only: ChatGPT finds and reads, while saving shortlists, sending outreach and starting new reports stay in the Octohog web app. Requires an Octohog account. Sign in with OAuth; ChatGPT sees only your workspace.
defaultPrompt: Find 10 UGC creators on TikTok who fit my brand.
What changed across my competitors this week?
How are my creator campaigns doing?

positive.prompt: What changed across my competitors this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the last 7 days across the tracked competitors: who posted most, new accounts or signals, and notable formats, with dates. Uses only competitors tracked in the workspace.

positive.description: Script from one competitor's recent posts
positive.prompt: Analyze Speak's posts from the last 7 days, study their hooks, and write me a 30-second script in that style.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads Speak's posts in that window with hooks, captions, stored transcripts and views, cites the posts it used, says how much of each script was captured, then writes a new script.

positive.prompt: Compare Praktika and Airlearn over the last week.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows posts, views, active creators, new signals and top angle for both competitors over the last 7 days, side by side.

positive.prompt: How are my creator campaigns doing?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workspace's campaigns with status, then reports the active Creator Tracking campaign's creators, delivered posts and best performers. Shows no payment amounts or creator contact details.

positive.prompt: Show me steph.lingo's latest posts and how they performed.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the roster creator's display name, handles, campaigns and latest posts with views and dates. Shows no email address or phone number.

negative.description: Write action: Radar changes are not available
negative.prompt: Add Babbel to my competitors on Radar and start tracking its TikTok.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that Octohog's tools are read-only, so it cannot add or track a competitor, says this is done on Radar in the Octohog web app, and takes no action.

negative.description: Creator contact details are never returned
negative.prompt: What is steph.lingo's email address and phone number?
negative.expected_behavior: Says creator contact details are not available through Octohog and offers the creator's handles and recent posts instead.

negative.prompt: Export every post from all my competitors since they started, with full transcripts, as a CSV.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that posts are read one competitor at a time within the last 90 days and offers a scoped request instead of a bulk export.

review.commerce_description: Octohog's plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: find UGC creators who fit your brief, with ranked matches and the reason each one fits. Ask what changed across your TikTok and Instagram competitors, read their posts with hooks, captions and transcripts, compare two competitors, write scripts in a competitor's style, and check your creator campaigns, roster creators, Video Blueprints and Creator Deep-Dives. All read-only.
